incident_updates.body:
ZetaChain has announced a migration of its token and deprecation of the native L1 network. Coinbase will support the migration of ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) to ZetaChain (ZETA) on the Ethereum network from December 7-10, 2026.

ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) order books have been moved to limit-only mode.

Ahead of the migration, the following ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) services will be impacted:

- Trading of ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) will be disabled on December 7, 2026.
- Sends and receives of ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) will be disabled from December 7, 2026.

Your tokens will be converted at a rate of approximately 1 ZETACHAIN : 1 ZETA. There will be no transaction fees associated with the conversion.

If you wish to opt-out of this automatic conversion please send your ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) to a compatible self-custody wallet before December 7, 2026.

You can find more details about the migration here: https://hub.zetachain.com/governance/proposal/70

If you hold ZetaChain (ZETA) on the Ethereum network, you are not affected by this migration. Coinbase will maintain support and trading for ZETA.

Please do not send ZETACHAIN to your Coinbase deposit addresses on the ZetaChain network on or after December 7, 2026, as these funds will not be recoverable.

If you have any questions regarding this update, please visit: https://help.coinbase.com/en

incidents.name: Aerodrome Finance (AERO) and Velodrome Finance (VELO) Migration

incident_updates.body: These migrations have now completed.

Reminder: send and receive support of Aerodrome Finance (AERO) and Velodrome Finance (VELO) will be temporarily disabled from November 2 - 4, 2026. Trading of VELO will be disabled on November 2, 2026. Trading of AERO will not be impacted.

Any AERO or VELO that remains on platform as of November 2, 2026 will be converted to the new Aero (AERO) token. AERO converts at a rate of 1:1 and VELO converts at a rate of approximately 0.044 AERO per VELO.

If you do not wish for your tokens to be converted, please send them to a compatible self-custody wallet before November 2, 2026. Tax consequences may apply. Please consult your local tax professional.

After the migration, Coinbase will no longer support deposits or withdrawals of the legacy AERO token. Please do not send the legacy AERO token to your Coinbase deposit address after the migration is complete, as these deposits may not be recoverable.

If you have any questions regarding this update, please visit: https://help.coinbase.com/en

Aerodrome Finance and Velodrome Finance previously announced a merger into Aero with a new AERO token. Coinbase will support the migration of Aerodrome Finance (AERO) and Velodrome Finance (VELO) to the new Aero (AERO) token from November 2-4, 2026.

What does this mean for you? Read more in the thread ⬇️

Ahead of the migration, the following services will be impacted:

- Sends and receives of AERO and VELO will be temporarily disabled from November 2 - 4, 2026.
- Please refrain from depositing or transferring AERO or VELO during this time.
- VELO order books have been moved to limit-only mode. Trading of VELO will be disabled on November 2, 2026.
- Trading of AERO will not be impacted.

AERO will be converted to the new AERO token at a rate of 1:1. VELO will be converted to AERO at a rate of approximately 0.044 AERO per VELO. There will be no transaction fees associated with the conversion.

If you wish to opt-out of this automatic conversion please send your AERO or VELO to a compatible self-custody wallet before November 2, 2026. Tax consequences may apply. Please consult your local tax professional.

After the migration, Coinbase will no longer support deposits or withdrawals of the legacy AERO token. Please do not send the legacy AERO token to your Coinbase deposit address after the migration is complete, as these deposits may not be recoverable.

You can find more details about the migration here: https://aero.xyz/articles/aero-launch-update-all-systems-go/

If you have any questions regarding this update, please visit: https://help.coinbase.com/en.
